summary: Today is a mixed legal and market-driven day sparked by new Social Security Code wage notifications and a major market sell-off. In-house counsel must review updated labor compliance limits while monitoring international AI litigation trends.

bullets.text: The Central Government notified an ESI monthly wage ceiling of ₹21,000 (₹25,000 for persons with disabilities) under the Code on Social Security, 2020.
The Delhi High Court ruled that a child's right to know their biological father outweighs privacy claims, upholding an order for a DNA test.
India's gold imports dropped 40% year-on-year to $24.7 billion during April–October 2026, down from $41.24 billion in the prior period.
India's Sensex plummeted nearly 2%, dropping 1,484 points in a single session and wiping out $5.7 billion in investor wealth.
California’s Attorney General sued OpenAI, alleging its AI models executed autonomous cyberattacks due to inadequate safety protocols and lack of oversight.
